title: Blessed Rain
overview: Danji abruptly relinquishes his position as leader and leaves Team Blackout. Megumi chases after him and challenges him to a Vanguard Fight in order to express the feelings that she cannot put into words.

title: Exspecta vs Bastion / Reboot
overview: A conflicted Yu-yu helps the newly appointed team leader Tohya as he works tirelessly at various odd jobs to repair Wonder Hill. Tomari suggests they have a Vanguard Fight. Yu-yu vs Tohya. What lies beyond this rematch?

title: Maiden Mannerism / Reconciliation
overview: Yu-yu and Tohya worry about Megumi, who had suddenly disappeared after Danji's departure. In order to reach her, Yu-yu and friends decide to...

title: Nordlinger \ Infiltration
overview: The team known as "The Daybreak" is lead by the mysterious Mirei Minae. Daybreak continues their hunt for banners everywhere in order to promote their ideal image of Vanguard. To uncover their true intentions, Danji makes contact with Haruka.

title: Sealed Blaze Maiden \ Face Off
overview: Though Mirei enjoys their secret rendezvous, Danji behaves awkwardly. To close the distance between them, Mirei challenges Danji to a fight.

title: Greedon \ Gluttony
overview: Shinobu and Zakusa await the arrival of Yu-yu, Megumi, and Tohya, who are on their way through the mountain trail to Daybreak's HQ in Nagoya. Shinobu's Greedon bares its fangs upon Megumi, who burns with anger.

title: Dark Trickstar \ Encounter
overview: Yu-yu and friends take a break at a bathhouse. Danji and Mirei appear before them on their way to grab a parfait. Having differences in the ideals of their teams, Yu-yu and Mirei decide to settle it with cardfigh

title: Your Name \ Reminiscence
overview: Mirei loses sight of Yu-yu and friends at a festival. While being rescued by Danji, Mirei is shocked as she realizes that Danji is Nadatsugu, the brother she thought passed away.

title: Megumi vs Haruka \ Recollection
overview: A match with Daybreak. Up first is the person known as the Queen of Ice, Haruka Sokawa, and her opponent is Megumi from Blackout.

title: Awakening of Chakrabarthi \ Flight
overview: Up next, Yu-yu and friends face a vengeful Shinobu, who appears to be relaxed and in top form.

title: Aurora Fierce Princess \ Right and Wrong
overview: Tohya prepares to settle his score against Masanori. A devious smile plays around Masanori's lips - what could he be up to...?

title: Bastion vs. Bruce \ Resolve
overview: The flames of Tohya's and Danji's fighting spirit rage silently as their fateful showdown begins. Their resolves clash, and the winner is...?!

title: overDress \ Showdown
overview: Yu-yu climbs to the top of Nagoya Castle for a cardfight against Mirei. With the very existence of their teams on the line, the time has come for a final showdown.
